name: GstarBIM
tagline: All-in-one BIM-oriented environment aimed at architects and interior designers in Gstarsoft’s portfolio.
meta_desc: Focuses on building modeling and documentation rather than plain 2D drafting; interoperability expectations should be validated against IFC/DWG exchange needs of your project. Use the GstarBIM user guide PDFs from the vendor help hub for version-specific scope.

terms.title: BIM Coordinate Sync
terms.short_def: Technical best practices for BIM Coordinate Sync inside GstarBIM.
terms.definition: BIM Coordinate Sync aligns origin points between building models and structural surveys.
terms.why_matters: Eliminates spatial mismatches when merging architectural design with MEP engineering.
common_pitfalls: Changing Project Base Point coordinates mid-project without notifying mechanical partners
Confusing standard grid origins with local building coordinate offsets

quiz.question: When working with BIM Coordinate Sync, which of the following represents a common technical pitfall?
options: Changing Project Base Point coordinates mid-project without notifying mechanical partners.
Failing to manually re-index the SQL server database.
Over-allocating virtual memory caches in the cloud settings.
Restricting linetype scales strictly to 1:1 paper coordinates.
quiz.explanation: Correct. A common pitfall is 'Changing Project Base Point coordinates mid-project without notifying mechanical partners.' As the editorial review notes: 'Eliminates spatial mismatches when merging architectural design with MEP engineering.'

terms.title: IFC Classification Map
terms.short_def: Technical best practices for IFC Classification Map inside GstarBIM.
terms.definition: IFC Classification Map assigns CAD building components to standard buildingSMART IFC schema classes.
terms.why_matters: Secures data integrity and parameters transfer during cross-platform BIM handoffs.
common_pitfalls: Leaving architectural components unmapped, which defaults them to generic proxies
Exporting IFC files with legacy parameters that conflict with building schemas

quiz.question: When working with IFC Classification Map, which of the following represents a common technical pitfall?

Restricting linetype scales strictly to 1:1 paper coordinates.
quiz.explanation: Correct. A common pitfall is 'Leaving architectural components unmapped, which defaults them to generic proxies.' As the editorial review notes: 'Secures data integrity and parameters transfer during cross-platform BIM handoffs.'

terms.title: Model-Based Schedule
terms.short_def: Technical best practices for Model-Based Schedule inside GstarBIM.
terms.definition: Model-Based Schedule extracts quantities, lengths, and surface areas directly from smart model objects.
terms.why_matters: Guarantees quantity schedule accuracy since numbers update automatically when the model is modified.
common_pitfalls: Overriding schedule tables manually instead of modifying model elements
Filtering schedule criteria incorrectly, which excludes relevant building objects

quiz.question: When working with Model-Based Schedule, which of the following represents a common technical pitfall?
options: Overriding schedule tables manually instead of modifying model elements.
Failing to manually re-index the SQL server database.
Over-allocating virtual memory caches in the cloud settings.
Restricting linetype scales strictly to 1:1 paper coordinates.
quiz.explanation: Correct. A common pitfall is 'Overriding schedule tables manually instead of modifying model elements.' As the editorial review notes: 'Guarantees quantity schedule accuracy since numbers update automatically when the model is modified.'

faqs.question: How do I align BIM coordinate systems with standard DWG files?
faqs.answer: Use the Project Base Point tool to register the origin coordinates and rotation angle relative to the survey point before starting modeling.

faqs.question: What IFC schemas are supported for export in GstarBIM?
faqs.answer: GstarBIM supports IFC2x3 and IFC4 schemas. Choose the coordination view template recommended by your project team.

faqs.question: Can I create schedules that update automatically?
faqs.answer: Yes, BIM schedules are linked to object metadata. Modifying doors, walls, or windows updates the quantities in real time.
